description: Utility functions for exporting DOM content to PNG and PDF formats, including download triggers, using 'html-to-image' and 'jspdf' libraries. Frontend-only, no backend calls.

methods.name: downloadDataUrl
methods.description: Triggers a browser download for a given data URL and filename.

methods.name: exportNodeToPng
methods.description: Converts a DOM node to a PNG data URL and optionally triggers a download.

methods.name: exportNodeToPdf
methods.description: Converts a DOM node to a PDF by first converting to PNG and embedding into jsPDF, then triggers download.
